title: MVP V4-3 pure policy evaluator and structured rejects
brief: Implement the pure policy evaluation layer on top of the V4-2 data model: read-only policy view, PolicyDecision enum, sender_filter, same-domain routing restriction, default behavior, cosign_required for selected policy actions, and stable structured policy rejects aligned between preflight and apply. Do not implement emergency routing balance redirection/finalization behavior beyond reject/decision scaffolding reserved for V4-4.

delegations.prompt_summary: Prepare reuse map for pure V4 policy evaluator, preflight/apply alignment, structured rejects, risks, and tests.
Implement pure V4-3 policy evaluator and structured rejects: PolicyDecision, evaluate_policy, policy gate before mutation, routing/sender/default/cosign/finalized rejects, and focused tests.
Validate V4-3 policy evaluator with cargo checks and policy_ tests.
Add missing V4-3 focused tests for default_behavior incoming transfer default-deny and tampered cosign negative.
Retest V4-3 after added default_behavior and tampered cosign tests.
Independent review of V4-3 pure policy evaluator, structured rejects, and semantic boundary versus V4-4.
Re-review after docs clarified V4-3 minimal sender_filter/default_behavior/cosign semantics.

notes: Simplicity constraints: evaluator must be pure/read-only; no VM/DSL/callbacks/dynamic dispatch; no new background task/channel. Existing ReadLints diagnostics on snapshot/types.rs appear stale after V4-2 cargo checks/reviews. Initial pwm-testing PARTIAL found missing default_behavior incoming transfer test and tampered cosign negative; pwm-coding added both; retest PASS: cargo check -p pwm-core, cargo check -p pwmd, cargo test -p pwm-core policy_ (11/11), and both named tests individually. Review PASS_WITH_NITS flagged semantic scaffolds for sender_filter/default_behavior/cosign role; docs/rfc/6-policy-engine.md and docs/plans/mvp_v4.md now explicitly mark these as V4-3 minimal semantics, with rescue-address cosign and membership semantics deferred to V4-4/V4-5. Re-review PASS; final cosmetic wording aligned.
